provenance.robot_reduced_order_constants: fixed numeric snapshot of the existing provisional operational response scales; they are identification-side robot nuisance constants, not fitted interface parameters
provenance.interface_parameters: candidate physical Kelvin-Voigt Kt/Kr/D scales from the frozen nominal interface
provenance.command_input: recorded executable robot cuff wrench at the robot cuff reference point

approximations: diagonal constant robot operational-space mass and inertia
bias/posture terms are assumed handled by the inherited loaded low-level execution command
recorded executable wrench is zero-order held over each 5 ms measurement interval
robot joint configuration, Jacobian variation, torque saturation dynamics, and bed reaction are not propagated
Human dynamics use the fixed Stage-5 Human model
interface displacement and twist are recomputed from robot/Human relative kinematics every 0.25 ms substep
